responsibility: Implements the predictive commoning loop optimization, which reuses values from earlier iterations as a loop-local form of CSE/strength reduction focused on memory references. It groups data references by dependence components, filters suitable chains, determines reuse distances and roots, optionally combines chains, inserts initializer/finalizer code and PHIs, can unroll loops to eliminate latch copies, and updates loop-closed SSA and CFG state after transforming memory-based recurrences into scalar temporaries.
